pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): Mob.$(br2)Mob farms drop the $(item)experience$() of their recipe (the recipe's $(thing)xp$() field). It builds up in the farm; press the $(item)xp$() button on the farm screen to collect it. Resource Farms with a $(item)Smelter$() card give furnace experience for every smelted item, without this card.
